items.title: CISA Adds TrueConf Vulnerability to KEV Catalog Following Active Exploitation
items.description: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has officially added a critical vulnerability affecting TrueConf software to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog. Tracked as CVE-2026-3502, this security flaw is currently facing active exploitation in the wild. items.title: 2,000+ FortiClient EMS Instances Exposed Online Amid Active RCE Vulnerability Exploits in the Wild
items.description: The Shadowserver Foundation has issued an urgent warning to FortiClient Enterprise Management Server (EMS) administrators after identifying over 2,000 publicly accessible instances globally, two of which are now confirmed to be actively exploited through critical unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities. items.title: Google DeepMind Researchers Warn Hackers Can Hijack AI Agents Through Malicious Web Content
